user.title: Connect to Chauffeur
user.description:
Internal URL of the Chauffeur add-on, including scheme and port, e.g. http://local-chauffeur:8000. Use the hostname shown on the add-on's info page.

The service token comes from Chauffeur: Config → People → Argyle. Leave it empty only while Chauffeur is still trusting your local network.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Chauffeur at that URL: {error}
